ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: PRC Anti-Money Laundering Law (2024 Revision, adopted November 8, 2024, effective January 1, 2025); PRC Company Law (2023 Revision, effective July 1, 2024); PRC Foreign Investment Law (effective January 1, 2020); Administrative Measures for Beneficial Owner Information of Legal Persons and Other Organizations (PBOC and SAMR Order No. 3, effective November 1, 2024); Taiwan Money Laundering Control Act, consolidated version; Taiwan Counter-Terrorism Financing Act; Taiwan Company Act; and Taiwan Regulations Governing Permission for Investment by People from the Mainland Area.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation of each corporate shareholder and investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) or the delegated municipal/provincial market regulation bureau in the People's Republic of China, or corresponding registry for other corporate shareholders
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Parallel exclusive routes: (A) Hague Apostille route, applicable only when the receiving jurisdiction is an Apostille Convention member: notarize the certificate, obtain an apostille from the PRC Ministry of Foreign Affairs or authorized local foreign affairs office, then stop; consular legalization must not be added. (B) Consular Legalization route, applicable only when the receiving jurisdiction is not an Apostille Convention member: notarize, authenticate through the PRC Ministry of Foreign Affairs, legalize at the destination consulate, then stop; apostille must not be added. Never combine A and B.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing or Certificate of Continuance
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) or the corporate registry of the shareholder's place of incorporation, or MOEA Department of Commerce if the shareholder is a Taiwan-registered company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Parallel exclusive routes: (A) Hague Apostille route for use in an Apostille Convention state: notarize, apostille at the competent foreign affairs authority, and stop; no consular legalization. (B) Consular Legalization route for use in a non-Apostille state: notarize, authenticate at the foreign affairs ministry, legalize at the relevant consulate, and stop; no apostille. The two paths are mutually exclusive and must never be chained.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Board Resolution or Power of Attorney authorizing pre-incorporation filings, bank account opening, and signatories
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of directors of the incorporating shareholder, followed by a notary public in the country of issuance
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Parallel exclusive routes: (A) Hague Apostille route: original resolution notarized, then apostilled only if the destination accepts apostille; no consular legalization follows. (B) Consular Legalization route: original resolution notarized, authenticated by the competent ministry, then legalized by the destination consulate; no apostille follows. Under no circumstance may an apostille and consular legalization be applied in sequence.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association or Memorandum and Articles of Association of the parent shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Shareholder corporate body and the registry where the Articles are filed, with notarial copy issuance by a notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Parallel exclusive routes: (A) Hague Apostille route: notarize, apostille through the competent authority, and stop. (B) Consular Legalization route: notarize, authenticate through the foreign affairs authority, legalize through the consulate, and stop. Apostille and consular legalization are alternative, mutually exclusive authentication systems.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter from the investor's principal settlement bank
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed commercial bank or settlement bank of the investor, issued on bank letterhead and, where required, notarized
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Parallel exclusive routes: (A) Hague Apostille route: if the destination is an Apostille state, notarize the bank officer signature and apostille only. (B) Consular Legalization route: if the destination is not an Apostille state, notarize, authenticate, and consularize only. Apostille and consular legalization are mutually exclusive paths and cannot be sequenced.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: UBO Register Extract or notarized Beneficial Ownership Declaration Form
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: SAMR/PBOC beneficial ownership register extract, or notarized declaration by the corporate shareholder's legal representative, supplemented by the Taiwan AML/CFT UBO declaration where Taiwan registration applies
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Parallel exclusive routes: (A) Hague Apostille route: notarize, apostille at the competent authority, and stop. (B) Consular Legalization route: notarize, authenticate, then legalize at the destination consulate, and stop. The two routes are exclusive and never sequential.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-onboarding and continuous screening shall include: OFAC SDN and consolidated sanctions lists; UN Security Council consolidated sanctions and travel-ban lists; EU, UK, and domestic Taiwan/PRC sanctions or restricted-party lists; PBOC financial sanctions lists; SAMR blacklisted persons; local court enforcement and bankruptcy lists; and cross-border negative-news and watchlist databases. All UBOs, directors, shareholders, authorized traders, and settlement bank signatories must be screened before signature, then screened daily until engagement terminates. PEP status triggers enhanced due diligence, senior-management approval, and signed source-of-wealth and source-of-funds declarations. Any sanctions match is a hard stop; no waiver is permitted unless a competent regulatory authority issues an explicit license or de-listing is verified. Adverse media requires a written legal clearance memorandum and risk-rating uplift.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: SAMR National Enterprise Registration and Name Reservation Online Service (mainland China); MOEA Department of Commerce Company and Business Registration Online Application Portal (Taiwan, if Taiwan incorporation is elected)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Under PRC Company Law and Taiwan Company Act, a corporate name must be composed of four tiers: administrative division or geographical indicator; distinctive trade name in Chinese characters; industry or business-scope descriptor; and legal form suffix. Chinese script is mandatory for the statutory company name. An English name may be separately registered and must be a phonetic or semantic translation consistent with the Chinese name. Phonetic transliteration of foreign names is permitted only through the official one-name-at-a-time clearance system, and no name may be identical to, or deceptively similar to, a previously registered name in the same or related line of business.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the registry issues a written decision citing the basis. The applicant may file an administrative reconsideration appeal within 15 days with the registry's superior body or competent commercial authority. The appeal must include the rejected name, the registration filing number, corrected or distinguishing explanations, trademark or prior-right certificates, and any consent letters. For mainland China, the appeal is filed with SAMR; for Taiwan, with the Department of Commerce, Ministry of Economic Affairs, followed by administrative litigation if denied. The reviewing authority must respond within 30 days; a fresh alternative name may be filed simultaneously to preserve momentum. If the administrative appeal is denied, judicial review is available.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A pure virtual office or commercial mail-forwarding address is not acceptable as the registered office for a regulated algorithmic high-frequency proprietary trading entity. The tax authority will reject a mailbox address for corporate residence or effective-management analysis, and the settlement bank will require a physical trade floor, server co-location or dedicated data room, local compliance or operations officer, and original books and records. A serviced office with a dedicated desk, business address, name signage, and an inspectable boardroom may satisfy commercial substance requirements if banking and licensing approvals are obtained. A standalone virtual mailbox, however, is rejected for an ISIC 6499 financial-services HFT vehicle and may be used only as an ancillary mailing contact point.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Checklist of physical substance evidence: name plate at the registered office; lease agreement longer than one year; board meeting minutes held at the registered address; statutory books, seals, and UBO register; bank account-opening records; trading or order-router equipment or co-location agreement; compliance manual and AML training logs. Quantified risk: high, 75-85 percent within the first 12 months for licensed financial activity, and 60-70 percent for a non-licensed trading vehicle. Municipal tax authorities and financial regulators may conduct unannounced on-site inspections without prior notice, especially after any suspicious-transaction report; failure to produce a required item gives rise to fines, administrative orders, or license revocation.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory nil; professional handling is quoted under incorporation legal fees.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: SAMR or MOEA registry; official fee is exempt in mainland China, with any Taiwan MOEA tariff applied separately if Taiwan incorporation is elected
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official tariff exemption; legal preparation included in itemized legal fees.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization, translation, and authentication or apostille of parent documentation bundle comprising six corporate instruments
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public, certified translator, PRC Ministry of Foreign Affairs or authorized foreign affairs office, and destination consulate only where the consular route applies
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark: USD 30-80 per page of translation, USD 40-100 per notarized instrument, USD 50-150 per apostille or consular legalization, plus courier and handling costs.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Outside counsel and licensed AML/CFT compliance provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Fixed fee based on number of UBOs, entity layers, and filing complexity; hourly rate USD 250-500.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office and commercial substance facility set-up: serviced office with physical control point, initial quarter rent plus deposit pro-rata
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market rent benchmark USD 2,000-3,000 per month for regulated financial premises; three-month deposit and one-month advance.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal due diligence and incorporation drafting fee for joint-vehicle documentation, board authorizations, bye-laws, and name reservation motion
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Law firm and corporate service provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Blended hourly rate or fixed engagement fee; market benchmark USD 4,500-8,000 for a mid-market Sino-foreign JV with financial-licensing component.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP and sanctions screening software subscription, initial list mapping, and positive-match review under UN, OFAC, Taiwan, and PRC lists
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed screening-data vendor and compliance SaaS provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Annual subscription benchmark USD 850-2,500 depending on entity count and list coverage; initial mapping included in fixed fee.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Act of the Republic of China (公司法), Articles 2, 128-156, 172, 201, 208 and 387; Securities and Exchange Act (證券交易法), Articles 15-18 and 44-46; Regulations Governing Securities Firms (證券商管理規則), Articles 3-15; Statute for Investment by Foreign Nationals (外國投資條例), Articles 6-8; Regulations Governing Permission for Investment in Taiwan by Mainland People (大陸地區人民來臺投資許可辦法), for mainland-origin shareholders.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs, Department of Commercial Development (經濟部商業發展署) via the MOEA Online Company Registration Portal; inbound capital investment pre-approval from the MOEA Investment Commission (經濟部投資審議委員會).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Company Registration (公司登記申請書), filed under Articles 387 of the Company Act and the Regulations Governing Company Registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: NTD 200,000,000 (approximately USD 6,350,000) minimum paid-in capital mandated by Article 15 of the Regulations Governing Securities Firms for a proprietary securities dealer. The full subscription must be deposited and held in a domestic bank capital-verification account, verified by a certified public accountant's capital verification report, and the funds must remain earmarked for the licensed securities business until the Financial Supervisory Commission grants the operating license.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, at the extraordinary session of the first board of directors of Sino-Foreign Equity Joint Venture Limited: (1) the subscribed share allotments in the joint venture contract are ratified, and paid-in capital of NTD 200,000,000 is subscribed and deposited in the Company's capital-verification account at a licensed domestic bank; (2) the registered office is fixed at 12F, No. 88, Sec. 2, Xinyi Road, Taipei City; (3) the General Manager, Chief Financial Officer, and Chief Compliance Officer are appointed and authorized to file incorporation records, sign formation documents, open bank accounts, and hire employees; (4) the Chief Compliance Officer is directed to apply for the Financial Supervisory Commission securities dealer license. All prior actions are ratified.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs, Investment Commission (經濟部投資審議委員會)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the executed joint venture contract, shareholders' resolutions, and the algorithmic trading business plan through the Ministry's online Foreign Investment Application Portal. The Investment Commission issues a Foreign Investment Approval Letter which is the jurisdictional prerequisite for all downstream registrations. Mainland-origin shareholders must follow the separate mainland-investor pre-approval lane under the Regulations Governing Permission for Investment in Taiwan by Mainland People.
required_dossiers: Audited financial statements of foreign shareholders
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to the Investment Commission's supplementary-information notice within 30 calendar days; incomplete or non-responsive applications lapse. A revised filing may be resubmitted with corrected capital source documentation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name and Business Scope Pre-Approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs, Company Name and Business Scope Pre-Approval System
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Reserve the Chinese and English company names and pre-approve the business scope wording through the MOEA online name-search and reservation system. After reservation, execute the notarized articles of incorporation reflecting the approved corporate name, business scope, capital structure, and governance provisions.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the first-choice name is rejected for similarity or prohibited wording, resubmit within 7 days with two alternative names without additional statutory fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Paid-In Capital Deposit and CPA Verification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed domestic bank and certified public accountant
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary capital-verification bank account in the name of the company, remit NTD 200,000,000, and hold the funds in escrow-type custody. The certified public accountant conducts verification of subscription records, bank deposit certificate, and shareholding structure, then issues the statutory capital verification report.
required_dossiers: Bank capital verification account opening contract
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If remittance proof is incomplete, rectify within 3 banking days and reissue the CPA verification report before the registration submission deadline.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Registration Filing with Ministry of Economic Affairs
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs, Department of Commercial Development (經濟部商業發展署)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the completed Application for Company Registration together with the notarized articles, CPA capital verification report, board resolution minutes, registered office consent, and shareholder identity documents through the MOEA Company Registration Portal. Pay the statutory registration fee and receive the Company Registration Certificate and the unified business number.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Remedy any registry query within the statutory 15-day correction window; after correction, the authority reissues the registration certificate. Repeated deficiency risks rejection and a fresh filing with attributable delay risk.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax, Social Insurance, and Municipal Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Taxation Bureau of Taipei; Bureau of Labor Insurance; Taipei City Government
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File income tax and business tax registration within 15 days after company registration, obtain the uniform invoice (VAT) registration, establish withholding and payroll accounts, and register as an employer with labor and national health insurance authorities. Obtain the municipal business premise license for the trading office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late-registration penalties may be abated by filing a written waiver petition supported by reasonable-cause justification with the National Taxation Bureau; insurance registration retroactivity requires formal employer declaration corrections.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Financial Supervisory Commission Licensing and Exchange Participation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Financial Supervisory Commission, Securities and Futures Bureau; Taiwan Stock Exchange; Taipei Exchange; Taiwan Depository and Clearing Corporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for the Securities Dealer License for proprietary trading under the Securities and Exchange Act. Submit proof of paid-in capital, compliance manual, internal control systems, risk control infrastructure, AML program, and ultra-low-latency trading system architecture including colocation arrangements. After license issuance, apply for securities dealer membership with the Taiwan Stock Exchange or Taipei Exchange and open clearing and settlement accounts with the Taiwan Depository and Clearing Corporation.
required_dossiers: Company Registration Certificate and unified business number
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to any FSC conditions or deficiencies within 60 calendar days; denial or unreasonable condition may be contested through administrative appeal under the Securities and Exchange Act and the Administrative Appeal Act.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Financial Supervisory Commission, Securities and Futures Bureau (金融監督管理委員會證券期貨局)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Securities Dealer License for Proprietary Trading (證券商自營業務許可證照)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Environment, Environmental Management Bureau (環境部環境管理署)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt Registration - Category IV office and information services premises; no EIA report or registration is required because the activity involves no manufacturing facility, energy generation, or listed development type under the Environmental Impact Assessment Act.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No process wastewater or VOC emission sources; sanitary sewage must comply with Water Pollution Control Act effluent standards (BOD no more than 30 mg/L, COD no more than 100 mg/L, suspended solids no more than 30 mg/L) for municipal sewer discharge; backup generator and cooling equipment noise shall not exceed 65 dB(A) at the property boundary; obsolete server hardware and electronic waste must be routed to licensed recyclers under the Waste Disposal Act.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification under the Fire Services Act including fire alarm, sprinkler system, emergency lighting, and evacuation route inspection by the Taipei City Fire Department; structural load inspection certificate covering trading floor and server racks; workplace safety inspection under the Occupational Safety and Health Act; low-voltage electrical installation inspection; and business premise occupancy clearance issued before employee occupation.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry of Finance, R.O.C. (Taiwan), acting through the National Taxation Administration and its regional National Tax Administrations (for a Taipei-based JV, the Taipei National Tax Administration applies); primary taxpayer portal is the Ministry of Finance Tax Web (税務入口網, www.etax.nat.gov.tw), with the E-Invoice Integration Service Platform (www.einvoice.nat.gov.tw) for invoice clearance. Company law registration is administered separately by the Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA) through the primary registration portal (公司及商業登記一站式申請作業).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A Sino-Foreign Equity Joint Venture incorporated in Taiwan as a limited company or company limited by shares first obtains incorporation and foreign-investment approval from MOEA, after which an 8-digit Unified Business Number (UBN) is automatically allocated through the integrated company registration workflow; the UBN serves as the single statutory tax ID for corporate income tax, business tax (VAT), withholding tax, and customs. The company must then file the standard profit-seeking enterprise registration application (營利事業設立登記) and the VAT registration application (營業人設立登記) with its Regional National Tax Administration, and register as a tax withholding agent. Foreign enterprises without a fixed place of business in Taiwan obtain a separate withholding tax ID (扣繳統一編號) through a tax agent, while foreign electronic service providers meeting the NTD 480,000 annual threshold register under the simplified VAT scheme for foreign e-service providers on the MOF E-Service platform.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation — the JV, being a juridical person under the Taiwan Company Act, is a resident enterprise subject to 20% corporate income tax on worldwide income plus a 5% retained-earnings surcharge on undistributed earnings; branches of foreign enterprises are taxable only on Taiwan-source income under territorial sourcing rules; no pass-through election exists for corporate shareholders, whereas sole proprietorships and partnerships are fiscally transparent and pass profits to owners; the entity is simultaneously registered as a VAT business entity at the 5% standard business tax rate.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Taiwan does not operate a check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch neutrality election regime. Available statutory elections include: (1) consolidated corporate income tax filing election available to a domestic parent holding 100% of the shares of domestic subsidiaries, subject to MOF conditions; (2) voluntary standard VAT registration for businesses below the NTD 200,000 monthly turnover threshold; (3) a one-off simplified VAT registration election for foreign electronic service providers; (4) Free Trade Port Zone and export-processing-zone status elections carrying zero-rating or exemption treatments; (5) place-of-effective-management (PEM) rebuttal rules under Article 43-4 of the Income Tax Act that may recharacterize an offshore company managed and controlled in Taiwan; and (6) CFC attribution rules effective from 2023 with specified de-minimis exemptions and controlled-company elections. Thin capitalization and interest limitation rules under Article 24-3 operate irrespective of entity classification.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value-Added and Non-Value-Added Business Tax (加值型及非加值型營業稅), commonly described as Taiwan Business Tax (VAT), governed by the Business Tax Act (加值型及非加值型營業稅法).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: NTD 200,000 in average monthly taxable sales for a Taiwan-established business, below which the JV may either register voluntarily as a standard VAT taxpayer or be taxed as a small-scale operator at a reduced 1% rate; foreign electronic service providers supplying eservices or cloud services to Taiwan persons become compulsorily registrable where annual consideration exceeds NTD 480,000. Proprietary high-frequency trading profits obtained by a securities or futures trader are not within the business tax base and instead attract the Securities Transaction Tax at 0.3% (temporarily 0.15% for ETFs or other elective rates) or the Futures Transaction Tax at statutory contract-specific rates.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: All standard VAT taxpayers must issue Uniform Invoices; electronic invoices (E-invoices) are the default statutory instrument and must be transmitted to the MOF E-Invoice Integration Service Platform through API, XML, or JSON machine-to-machine integration. Clearance rules are time-boxed rather than real-time: B2B E-invoices must be uploaded within 48 hours of issuance and B2C cloud invoices within 48 hours, after which the platform attributes a unique invoice number and random check code; no Latin-American-style pre-approval stamping exists, but the 48-hour upload duty is enforced through bi-monthly Form 401 returns and system-based cross-matching audits. Issuance outside these windows is treated as late filing subject to penalties and loss of input-credit substantiation rights.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating at 0% business tax applies to: (1) export of goods with an accepted customs export declaration; (2) services rendered in Taiwan but used or consumed outside Taiwan, and services in connection with international trade, provided the consideration is received in foreign currency and documented by a foreign-exchange settlement certificate; (3) international transport and transport-related services; (4) sales of goods to foreign vessels or aircraft; and (5) sales within Free Trade Port Zones to foreign or non-customs-territory customers. For the JV, only separately contracted cross-border algorithmic trading, research, or consultancy services consumed offshore by non-Taiwanese clients may qualify; the JV's own proprietary trading and market-making profits fall outside the business tax scope and therefore generate no input VAT credit entitlement, requiring careful segregation of service revenue from trading principal gains.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration for goods (出口報單, Form N5203/N5204) or, for service exports, a signed cross-border service agreement identifying the offshore recipient and foreign-currency consideration
Commercial invoice issued by the JV stating the 0% VAT rate and referencing the export or cross-border service transaction
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical departure of goods from Taiwan customs territory
Foreign exchange settlement book (結匯水單) or bank inward remittance certificate evidencing crediting of foreign currency proceeds to a Taiwan or offshore account of the JV
Zero-rated E-invoice and packing list as applicable
Supporting operational records for algorithmic services (trade logs, order-routing reports, service reports) demonstrating offshore consumption for any zero-rated service claim
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export zero-rating is an audit priority. Where documentation is incomplete or the export or offshore service is fictitious, the tax authority reassesses the transaction at 5% VAT, adds interest, and under Article 51 of the Business Tax Act imposes a penalty up to five times the evaded tax; Article 52 additionally imposes up to five years imprisonment, detention, or fines for fraudulent evasion, and retroactive clawbacks of incorrectly claimed input VAT may reach five prior tax years. Under the Central Bank foreign-exchange regulations, export proceeds must be repatriated within 90 days of shipment (automatically extendable to 180 days; longer periods require central bank approval), and failure to repatriate may trigger recharacterization of revenue as non-export domestic taxable income at 20% CIT, loss of zero-rating status, and exchange-control penalties.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: The Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan) (中央銀行, CBC), acting in coordination with the Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) for the licensing and foreign-exchange declaration requirements applicable to a proprietary algorithmic high-frequency trading entity.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The New Taiwan Dollar (TWD) is fully convertible for current-account transactions, including dividend distributions, licence fees, and trade-related service payments, subject only to post-event declaration thresholds. Capital-account flows, including equity injections, shareholder loans, and derivative-related remittances, require CBC pre-approval or enhanced declaration through a domestic designated foreign-exchange bank. Profits remitted by a mainland China investor are permitted under the Statute for Investment by Foreign Nationals and the Regulations Governing Permission for Investment in Taiwan by People from the Mainland Area, provided the investment remains FSC-approved, the Taiwan JV files annual audited financial statements, corporate income tax and withholding tax obligations are settled, and the remittance is executed through a CBC-designated bank with an approved profit-repatriation certificate. For an algorithmic HFT market-making entity, trading spreads, rebates, and venue incentives are classified as service-export proceeds; the CBC will require foreign-exchange declaration on a financial-investment basis to the extent such proceeds are used to satisfy margin calls or clearing obligations at offshore venues.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under the Management of Foreign Exchange Act and the Regulations Governing Foreign Exchange Declaration, all export and service-export proceeds generated by the Taiwan JV must be credited to a designated foreign-exchange account at a CBC-authorized bank within 180 days from the earning event or declared electronically to the CBC upon receipt, whichever is earlier. There is currently no mandatory forced-conversion ratio for onshore export receipts; the JV may retain 100% of eligible foreign-currency proceeds in a designated multi-currency account, provided the balances are declared and categorised as export/service proceeds rather than investment or arbitrage balances. For algorithmic market-making revenues received from overseas exchanges, the same 180-day repatriation and declaration timeline applies, and any idle foreign-currency balance exceeding the entity's documented trading, hedging, and settlement needs must be converted to TWD at prevailing market rates or supported by an approved treasury hedging programme.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: CTBC Bank Co., Ltd. (中國信託商業銀行)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low to Medium for ancillary foreign-currency collection corridors; the core treasury and clearing functions must remain at a Taiwan-regulated bank. Offshore digital EMIs such as Airwallex, Payoneer, Revolut Business, and the Wise Platform are not authorised as banks by the CBC or the FSC, cannot hold a TWD current account, and cannot clear NTD positions. They may be used only to aggregate USD, EUR, or CNH rebate receivables from overseas exchanges before conversion and onward transfer to a Taiwan designated bank. The JV may utilise a licensed UK/EU EMI for fee aggregation, but such balances must be repatriated to the Taiwan operating account at least monthly to avoid classification as unauthorised offshore investment or CBC deemed-capital-flow treatment.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is mandatory for at least one Taiwan-nominated director or authorised signatory holding a Taiwanese National ID or Alien Resident Certificate, together with the registered corporate seal card (印鑑). Remote video onboarding is accepted only for the parent entity in mainland China to verify board resolutions and beneficial ownership attestations, but it cannot replace the Taiwan signatory interview. The FSC and CBC require a face-to-face interview at the branch, notarised parent-company resolutions, and submission of the corporate registration certificate. A wholly offshore director who is a mainland person without a Taiwan residence certificate will trigger enhanced due diligence and may be required to appoint a Taiwan resident signatory.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore directors and delegated trading mandates from a Shanghai or Hong Kong desk create ambiguity over who controls account disbursements and payment instructions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Central-management-and-control substance opinion prepared by a Taiwan tax adviser; Taiwan board meeting minutes evidencing at least two physical board meetings per year at the registered Taiwan office; executed dual-authority control attestation requiring both a Taiwan-resident signatory and a remote signatory on every payment instruction; a completed CBC beneficiary-nomination form for the actual controller; and FATCA/CRS self-certifications with each controlling person's tax identification number, passport, and residential address.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: China-to-Taiwan equity injections must be routed through designated foreign-exchange banks via SWIFT MT103 or MT202, using the parent company's registered ODI capital-remittance documentation established under SAFE. The Taiwan receiving bank must submit a CBC foreign-exchange declaration under the financial-investment purpose category applicable to a mainland-area investor's equity subscription, and the funds must initially be lodged in a capital escrow account opened at a Tier-1 Taiwan bank. Supporting documents include the FSC investment permit, share-subscription agreement, board minutes approving the capital call, source-of-funds evidence from the PRC parent's audited financial statements, and a tax-compliance certificate. Escrowed injection funds are released only after the CPA-issued capital verification certificate is filed with the Investment Commission and the corporate registration is updated. Routine working-capital remittances exceeding NTD 500,000 require CBC declaration; receipts in excess of NTD 10 million in a single session trigger enhanced verification and potential a 30-day verification hold if the purpose or beneficial owner cannot be fully substantiated. For margin obligations, the JV should route initial margin through the Taiwan custodian's omnibus clearing account to preserve segregation requirements under FSC regulations.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: The primary clearing rails are: (1) SWIFT MT103 for final foreign-currency disbursements to overseas brokers, exchanges, market-data vendors, and clearinghouses; (2) the CBC Interbank e-Payment System for real-time NTD settlement between the JV and local clearing members; (3) Fedwire via the Taiwan bank's USD correspondent for USD-denominated margin calls, settlement obligations, and US trading-venue collateral; and (4) Direct_Exchange_Clearing membership or a clearing-agent relationship for ultra-low-latency proprietary trades requiring segregated pre-funded balances. Commercial letters of credit are not a meaningful instrument for algorithmic HFT treasury except in limited cases where an exchange or prime broker requires collateral support in documentary form; the standard securities settlement cycle is T+1 for official exchange trades and T+0 for pre-funded balances. Outbound service-import payments (exchange listing fees, market-data licences) require a CBC service-import declaration and the attachment of the underlying invoice, beneficiary tax-residence statement, and service agreement. Securities-related settlement flows between the JV and its clearing broker are executed via MT202/MT203 instruction paired with exchange-system matching records carrying at least 100-millisecond timestamps for forensic audit integrity.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Delivery-based onshore USD/TWD outright FX forwards executed with a CBC-designated foreign-exchange bank, restricted to hedges of documented receivables or payables and a maximum tenor of 12 months
Cross-currency swaps (USD/TWD) for matched cash-flow hedges of the capital escrow and future profit-distribution schedule, with principal notional equal to the audited net-asset injection
Foreign-exchange swaps for rolling settlement balances, permitted only when the underlying exposure is a trade invoice, an export-rebate receivable, or an approved capital-account event

Exchange-traded foreign-currency futures on US or offshore venues for delta-hedging the non-TWD portion of the algorithmic inventory, provided no deliverable TWD obligation is created for the Taiwan bank
FX options with cash settlement strictly in USD, limited by maturity tranche to the documented USD receivable amounts

Onshore non-deliverable forwards referencing TWD are not recommended; offshore NDFs may be executed only with a non-Taiwan counterparty, settled entirely in USD or CNH, and only after obtaining a CBC offshore hedging confirmation for the specific transaction

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual profit-seeking enterprise income tax return and reconciled financial statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Taxation Bureau, Ministry of Finance, Taiwan (ROC)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually from 1 May through 31 May following the calendar fiscal year end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of NT$1,500 to NT$30,000; understatement or non-payment attracts surcharge and interest; persistent non-filing may lead to tax authority estimation, compulsory collection action, and potential administrative strike-off for invalid business status.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual general meeting minutes and statutory financial statement package approval
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs, Company Registration Repository
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Shareholders meeting must be convened within 6 months after the fiscal year end; any registration-triggering resolution must be filed within 15 days after the meeting
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Directors may be fined NT$10,000 to NT$50,000 by the competent authority for convening the annual meeting late; repeated non-compliance can result in an order to dissolve the company or application for court-ordered strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual AML/CFT ultimate beneficial ownership confirmation and record update
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Financial Supervisory Commission and designated AML authority for financial and proprietary trading entities
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 31 March for the preceding calendar year; immediate re-confirmation within 5 business days upon any shareholding transfer or UBO change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine up to NT$1,000,000 under the Money Laundering Control Act for missing, false, or untimely UBO confirmation; repeated breach may lead to license suspension or revocation for regulated financial service providers.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: CPA audit is mandatory for non-public companies when paid-in capital exceeds TWD 30 million, or when the competent authority designates the company as being of special public interest; otherwise audit is optional but recommended for foreign-invested entities.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Taiwan Financial Reporting Standards (TIFRS), which are IFRS-converged; small non-public enterprises may apply the local SME accounting standards where TIFRS is unnecessarily complex.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: As a licensed proprietary trading entity, the company must maintain a current ultimate beneficial ownership record. Annual confirmation is conducted at the shareholders meeting, and each shareholding transfer requires re-certification of the new beneficial owner before the transfer is recorded. A UBO change of 10% or more of share capital triggers immediate re-documentation in the statutory register and availability for AML inspection.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members, Register of Directors, Minute Book

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 900-2,800 per annum for professional registered office and corporate agent services in Taipei
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 12,000-30,000 per annum for a certified audit of an active proprietary high-frequency trading entity under TIFRS

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No statutory tax holiday for proprietary algorithmic trading. General incentives include a 15% research and development investment credit (capped at 30% of tax payable), a 5-year reduced rate or exemption for eligible new-technology startups under the Statute for Industrial Innovation, and participation exemptions for qualifying equity gains. The standard 5% retained-earnings surtax on undistributed profits raises the aggregate effective rate on distributed earnings for companies lacking incentive eligibility.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Profit-Seeking Enterprise Income Tax Return (Form 20) filed through the Taiwan Tax E-Filing portal (https://e.tax.nat.gov.tw)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual final return; provisional estimated return due by 31 July of the current taxable year
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Final return must be filed on or before the last day of the fifth month after the fiscal year-end (31 May for calendar-year entities). A one-month extension may be granted upon application for accounting or uncontrollable causes; interest runs from the original due date in all cases.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Aggregate Taiwan-source gross income, including realised trading gains, market-making fees, clearing rebates, and any foreign-source income attributable to the Taiwan PE
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report all trading revenue booked through Taiwan accounts; translate foreign-currency amounts using the annual average exchange rate published by the Taiwan central bank.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 20 - Cost of Goods Sold / Direct Trading Costs
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Execution fees, exchange membership costs, low-latency connectivity leases, clearing charges, and infrastructure depreciation directly allocable to revenue generation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Allocate costs consistently with audited financial statements; intercompany service charges require contemporaneous cost-allocation documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Profit before income tax computed under Taiwan GAAP and reconciled to audited financial statements
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Reconcile differences in Schedule 16; head-office general expenses are non-deductible unless supported by an arm's length cost sharing arrangement.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net operating profit adjusted for permanent and temporary differences, tax-exempt income, and loss carry-forward utilisation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply the 5-year loss carry-forward strictly against current-year taxable income; unavailable losses lapse permanently.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax computed at the 20% statutory rate before foreign tax credits and investment credits
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The declared tax liability remains payable even if treaty relief or investment credits are expected.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Credit for foreign income taxes paid on foreign-source income included in Taiwan taxable income
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach certified foreign tax returns and proof of payment; credit is limited to the Taiwan tax attributable to foreign-source income.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: monthly surcharge of 3% of unpaid tax, rounded up to the nearest month, capped at 30% of the assessed tax, plus interest at the postal savings rate. Understatement penalties under Article 110 of the Income Tax Act: one time for negligent understatement, and two to three times for intentional concealment. Non-filing after the tax authority's summons exposes the responsible officer to a separate fine of up to NT$30,000 under the Tax Collection Act.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 21% of gross dividends paid to a non-resident shareholder without a Taiwan PE. Under the Cross-Strait Agreement, the rate is reduced to 10%, or 5% if the beneficial owner is a company directly holding at least 25% of the distributing entity's capital.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The Chinese shareholder must obtain a Tax Resident Certificate from the Chinese tax authority for the fiscal year of the dividend, complete a beneficial-ownership declaration affirming no Taiwan PE, and submit a reduced-withholding application to the Taiwan withholding agent. The agent then files the application with the National Tax Administration before the distribution; if full 21% is withheld pending approval, the excess is refundable by application within five years.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory WHT for non-resident enterprises without a Taiwan PE: interest at 20% of gross interest; royalties at 20% of gross royalties. Under the Cross-Strait Agreement, interest is capped at 10% (5% for qualified financial institutions) and royalties at 10%, subject to the same tax-residence and substance requirements.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Cross-border related-party transactions aggregating to TWD 50 million or more per year trigger the Local File; TWD 20 million triggers documentation when a related party is in a no-tax or low-tax jurisdiction. A Master File is required when the worldwide group revenue exceeds TWD 3 billion and the Taiwan entity's cross-border related-party turnover exceeds TWD 50 million. Contemporaneous documentation must be completed by the tax filing deadline and produced within 30 days of request.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Taiwan does not operate a standalone economic substance registration. However, the general anti-avoidance rule in Article 12-3 of the Income Tax Act, the principal-purpose test under the Cross-Strait Agreement, and the CFC rules apply to re-characterise entities without genuine commercial substance. The JV must maintain a real Taiwan head office, licensed trading systems, substantive trading staff, board minutes, risk and clearing functions, and decision-making records to withstand scrutiny.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Corporate Tax Evasion via Sham Trading Losses
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Recording wash-sale losses, fabricating late trade settlements, or routing profitable trading to an offshore SPV while showing artificial expenses in the Taiwan entity
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Article 110 of the Income Tax Act, a penalty of two to three times the underpaid tax; fraudulent evasion is criminally punishable under Article 41 of the Tax Collection Act with up to five years' imprisonment and a fine not exceeding NT$1,000,000. Interest accrues from the original due date.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign or direct the false return are jointly and severally liable for the unpaid tax and penalties. The tax authority may freeze personal bank accounts, attach real estate and remuneration, and apply for a travel ban on the responsible person until tax is secured. Fraud convictions result in personal imprisonment of the controlling director.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining a Taiwan entity with a nominal office and no genuine employees, trading systems, independent risk-management, or decision-making, while profits are shifted to a related foreign entity
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The tax authority may disregard the legal form, re-characterise the foreign affiliate's income as Taiwan-source, impose the 21% withholding on constructive dividends, and assess understatement penalties up to three times. Treaty relief under the Cross-Strait Agreement is denied under the principal-purpose test.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly structure the shell are personally liable under the Tax Collection Act for unpaid tax; personal assets may be seized and passports cancelled. The controlling shareholder, as principal organiser, may receive a five-year criminal sentence for fraudulent tax evasion.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Mispricing and Documentation Failure
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Pricing intercompany management fees, algorithmic licences, or risk guarantees outside arm's length; failing to prepare the Local File or Master File at the TWD 50 million threshold; or selecting a TP method unsupported by comparables
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The National Tax Administration may adjust taxable income upwards, impose one to three times the understated tax as a penalty, and add overdue interest. Failure to provide contemporaneous documentation shifts the burden of proof to the taxpayer and attracts a fixed penalty of up to NT$50,000.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The CFO and general manager who executed the TP policy without review can be named as responsible persons, subjected to restrictive travel during audit, and held jointly liable for penalties. Knowing falsification of the TP file exposes the certifying director to Article 41 criminal liability and imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Rapid pass-through moves of trading proceeds through nominee accounts, failure to file Suspicious Transaction Reports for anomalous high-frequency settlement behaviour, or using informal renminbi payment channels to repatriate profits
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Money Laundering Control Act, the entity faces fines from NT$1 million to NT$50 million for serious internal-control failures; knowingly handling criminal proceeds carries fines up to NT$100 million and imprisonment up to seven years for responsible persons. The Financial Supervisory Commission may revoke the firm's trading licence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers who ignore suspicious transactions are criminally indictable as accomplices, face civil liability to the clearing house, receive a travel embargo, and may be disqualified from financial-sector directorships for up to five years. Personal assets are attachable in regulatory enforcement actions.
